stem:
A student uses a flashlight to shine a beam of light on three different objects.

Which table describes what happens to the light beam as it interacts with each object?

options.label: F
options.text:
Object 1 Scattered
Object 2 Absorbed
Object 3 Reflected

options.label: G
options.text:
Object 1 Refracted
Object 2 Absorbed
Object 3 Reflected

options.label: H
options.text:
Object 1 Reflected
Object 2 Absorbed
Object 3 Refracted

options.label: J
options.text:
Object 1 Absorbed
Object 2 Refracted
Object 3 Scattered

visual_elements: Illustration of three flashlights each shining a beam of light on one of three boxes labeled Object 1, Object 2, and Object 3; The beams have different paths indicating scattering, absorption, reflection, and refraction.
